verdict: Ads are spending and converting, but lead tracking is broken and needs fixing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $1,045.48 ran through Google Ads and Google recorded 11 conversions — yet zero leads appear in your CRM, confirming a disconnect between the ad platform and your pipeline that is being repaired now. Until that tracking is restored, the true lead count under-reports. Separately, several planned milestones — including the booking bot, review campaign, financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating toggle — are overdue and being escalated this week. Google Business Profile actions, which ran at 113 over the full 28-day window, dropped to zero for the final three days of the period, which we are monitoring closely. Once tracking is confirmed clean and the overdue milestones are closed, the account will be in position to scale into the fall heating season on schedule.
